name: Newsletter
description: Mortar marketing newsletter, using central semantic tokens.

props.title: string
props.status: "idle" | "submitting" | "success" | "error" (success announces message, or a default, in a persistent status region)
props.id: string (the root element's id, e.g. an in-page link target)
props.className: string (layout only: margins or grid placement)
props.layout: "split" | "center" (default "split": the copy beside the form; center puts the copy above a centred form)
props.variant: "plain" | "panel" (default "plain": a section under a top rule; panel is a rounded, sunken card)

contract.usage: Import { Newsletter } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states. The root element exposes data-m-component for tests and consumers. It is not a styling hook. A persistent role="status" region announces the success message; errors stay on the field.
